rule: groups are ordered R18/R19 F1 order then acceptance order; index even -> train, odd -> held-out; the frozen R19 validation groups are forced held-out; while train < 12 and held-out > 5 the last held-out group is flipped to train (and, if held-out < 5, the last train group is flipped back).  Mirrors are atomic: a group never crosses the split
